reviewedData.aiFollowUpPlan:
Three to Six Months: The living room area near the fireplace should be rechecked to confirm the previous roof leak repair is holding up properly, especially if snow accumulation occurs during winter or spring months. The inspector recommends monitoring this location during wet weather to verify the repair is waterproof.  It is best practice to clean/replace filters at minimum when changing from cooling season to heating season.  Clean filters improve air quality as wells as increasing the life span of furnace and associated parts.

Twelve Months: The White Bathroom water staining below the toilet supply line requires rechecking to confirm the leak has been fixed and to assess moisture levels in the nearby baseboard and building materials. While nearby materials were dry at the time of inspection, ongoing monitoring every six months to a year is recommended to ensure the issue does not return.

Overall, the home is in reasonable condition, though monitoring of previous water damage areas and completion of air quality testing in certain spaces will help ensure continued home health.
